name: Jackson Gents
description: The Jackson Gents were an Italian-American youth gang from Williamsburg, Brooklyn, active from the mid-1950s through the late 1960s. Both Vito Genovese and Carlo Gambino recruited from the gang in the 1950s, and some members eventually transitioned into organized crime.

sources.title: New York City Italian Youth Gangs and the Mafia | New York City Fighting Gangs
